name: Rondanestien
description_md:
Rondanestien is a waymarked hiking route in Norway that covers a distance of 439.3 km. This route is classified as hard, a difficulty derived from its distance and ascent.

It is part of the national waymarked hiking network, and the line matches the official route published by turrutebasen. The trail passes within 900 m of MUNCH, within 1000 m of Oslo (Torp), and within 1100 m of the Museum of Cultural History.
